questions.question: Agree the wording about the 1739 Elements in both editions. The Russian State Library catalogue reproduces the title: Farquharson prepared an eight-book abridgement, and Ivan Satarov translated it from Latin. Proposed English wording: “In 1739, a Russian edition of Euclid’s Elements appeared in an eight-book abridgement prepared by Farquharson and translated from Latin by Ivan Satarov.” Proposed Russian wording: «В 1739 году вышло русское издание „Начал“ Евклида в сокращении до восьми книг, подготовленном Фарварсоном; с латыни его перевёл Иван Сатаров».
